audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Syndra wins all seven stages while Lux wins 52.42% over 4552 games — the packet itself flags this as a defect — and every full-layer phases[N].why described LUX winning the stage it credited to Syndra.
audit.why: The decisive lane fact is range: Lux Q 1175 and E 1100 versus Syndra Q 800 and W 925. Syndra cannot poke Lux without stepping 375 units inside Lux's Q. Syndra genuinely owns Level 3 (Q-E stun online) and Level 6 (Unleashed Power is point-and-click and executes), so those two rows stay hers and their whys were rewritten to say so.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4-5, first item and 2+ items moved to Lux with matching win[N] edits; rows 3 and 6 stay Syndra with whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 why credited Lux's Final Spark while the row was scored to Syndra, so the biggest spike in the lane was described twice from opposite sides.
audit.why: Unleashed Power is 120/100/80s, 675 range, point-and-click, and executes low targets per Transcendent. Final Spark is 60/50/40s at 3340 range. Both spikes are real; at 6 the point-and-click execute is the one that decides the lane, and Luden's is where Lux's Q-E-R takes over.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 120s point-and-click execute; phases[5].why keeps the Luden's spike on Lux's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields asserted "her Q out-ranges yours" (whys[0], spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, early, late, wants.foe[2]). It is false. breakdown.cooldowns also carried no cooldown number at all.
audit.why: Dark Sphere is 800 range; Lux's Q is 1175 and E 1100. Scatter the Weak is 650 range on a flat 15s and only stuns through a Dark Sphere it knocks into you — the interaction is sphere placement, not raw range. Dark Sphere is 7s, so her poke never stops, but she has to walk into your Q to use it.
audit.corrected: All six fields now state the real ranges and the sphere-line stun requirement; cooldowns now names 15s Scatter, 7s Q, 120s R and 12s Prismatic Barrier.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warned that stacking MR is the wrong answer.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions: Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to deal bonus TRUE damage, which resistances do not reduce.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid now says MR is a trap and to buy HP and dodge instead.

audit.why: 52.42% over 4552 games is the figure used, no tiers written.

audit.whatIsWrong: lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT: the cooldowns field carried no cooldown number.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Syndra out-ranges and out-trades you throughout. Her Q (Dark Sphere) out-ranges your Q and her E (Scatter the Weak) can stun you through her spheres if you facecheck. She farms safely and pokes you whenever you step to CS; hug minions and dodge sphere placements.

notes: I did not touch phases[N].rating on the flipped rows — the rating scale's polarity (owner-difficulty vs stage-strength) is not defined anywhere in the brief, and guessing it would have put a number on the page I could not justify. Rows 1,2,4-5,1st-item,2+ now read Lux with side and win[N] paired; rows 3 and 6 stay Syndra with rewritten whys. The packet's own defects array already flagged the all-Syndra chart as contradicting the 52.42% win rate. QA re-scope: previous edits to breakdown.cooldowns were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
